notes:
Lead from marketing webinar (Jan 15). Strong need for summary + auto-tagging to reduce TTR and manual triage. Uses Zendesk currently; evaluating Freshdesk as backup. Primary ask: 1) concise ticket/email summary (1-3 sentence) that includes intent and suggested category; 2) auto-tag taxonomy mapping -> Zendesk macros; 3) tool-calling support for internal macros (assign, escalate, create follow-up tasks); 4) reliable behavior during promotional spikes (expected up to ~2k reqs/min peak).

Security: must be able to run in VPC, SOC2 + SSO required, want KMS integration and audit logs visible in console. Data residency preference: US-only. Procurement sensitive to predictable billing (interested in Dedicated or committed burst capacity).

POC plan agreed: ingest 3 months of historical tickets (PII masked) -> generate summaries & tags -> measure tagging precision/recall and summary helpfulness via small agent panel. Current dev-run metrics: tagging precision ~82% on dev set; summaries judged "useful" by agents ~78%.

Quote from Head of Support (Maya Patel): "If summaries cut agent prep time by half, we can reallocate 12 FTEs to proactive work. But we need rock-solid fallbacks when marketing runs wild."

Integration notes: webhook-based macros in Zendesk, Freshdesk automation rules. They asked about Redwood function/tool-calling to create internal tasks and to fire webhooks back into Zendesk (must support idempotency). Requested example flow + sample macros.

Commercial: expecting $30k-$120k ARR depending on burst capacity pricing. Legal asked for standard DPA + SOC2 report. Procurement loop: legal -> security -> finance.

Open items: push PRD for tag taxonomy (they'll share by Feb 24), finalize SLA for 99.5% availability during spikes, confirm retention controls for transcript logs.
